question: Does a periodic quad-grid adjacency plus local Maekawa and Kawasaki checks select 18 axes x 23 stations or the declared 18-degree carrier x 23 stations?

test_contract.topology: periodic quad grid C_angular x C_23
test_contract.faces: one explicit quad per angular/station cell
test_contract.mountain_valley_assignment: angular perfect matching supplies one V edge per vertex; all remaining incident edges are M
test_contract.maekawa: M=3, V=1, therefore |M-V|=2 at every vertex
test_contract.kawasaki: four equal 90-degree sectors, therefore each alternating sum is 180 degrees

result: Both candidates pass the declared local necessary conditions. The checks do not select the carrier semantics.
disposition: HOLD mechanism binding until Human Owner selects whether 18 denotes an axis count or an 18-degree angular step. The existing SCC-003 demonstrator currently declares the latter.
claim_boundary: The test uses a toroidal periodic carrier. It is not a planar crease-pattern, global rigid-foldability, layer-order, collision, material, stress or physical self-support proof.
